subjective.content: Patient called by phone reporting bilateral forearm rash for approximately 10 days. Onset followed yard work (pulling weeds along the side of the house). Rash is red, bumpy, and intensely itchy, particularly at night, disrupting sleep. Denies fever or spread to other body areas. No new soaps or detergents. Tried OTC hydrocortisone with partial relief. NKDA, no prior known skin allergies.
